<!--
PR title format / 标题格式: type(scope): short summary
Example / 示例: feat(auth): add invite-code registration
Rules / 规范: Seikode-LLC/handbook (engineering-workflow.md)
-->

## Summary / 改了什么

<!-- What changed and why. Link the issue if there is one. / 改了什么、为什么改，有 issue 就附上链接。 -->

## Testing / 怎么测的

<!-- Commands you ran, devices or browsers you checked. / 跑了哪些命令，在哪些设备或浏览器上验证过。 -->

## Screenshots / 截图

<!-- Required for any UI change: before and after, phone and desktop width. Write "N/A" otherwise. / 改动 UI 必须附改前改后截图（手机宽度和桌面宽度），否则写 N/A。 -->

## Checklist / 自查清单

<!-- Check every box. If one does not apply, check it and write N/A. / 每一项都要勾上，不适用的也勾上并写 N/A。 -->

- [ ] I read the code standards and this PR follows them / 我已阅读代码规范，本 PR 符合规范
- [ ] UI changes follow the UI/UX guidelines, with screenshots above / UI 改动符合 UI/UX 规范，并附了截图
- [ ] Builds, lints, and tests pass locally / 本地构建、lint、测试均通过
- [ ] No secrets, keys, `.env` files, or personal data are committed / 没有提交密钥、`.env` 或个人数据
- [ ] Commits have no AI co-author trailers / 提交记录中没有 AI 合著者署名
- [ ] Docs (README, CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md) are updated if behavior changed / 行为有变化时已更新文档
